title: A benchmarking study of instance segmentation methods for photovoltaic cell defect detection using electroluminescence images
mechanism: Mask-classification / instance segmentation (Mask R-CNN, ConvNeXt, ConvNeXt-V2, Mask2Former via MMDetection) for EL defects.
adaptation: Mask2Former in semantic mode, Swin-T or R50 with ADE20K weights, 1-ch, 512 px; aimed at inactive (few blob regions per cell) and mIoU_rob; crack likely stays with the house model in a heterogeneous ensemble.
min_experiment: Arm Mask2Former semantic, 3 seeds vs house; inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; kill if inactive IoU < house and mIoU_rob < house - 0.01.
evidence: R: UCF-EL (crack, interconnect, contact, corrosion); ConvNeXt-V2 best: seg mAP50 0.602, seg mIoU 0.650, box mAP50 0.629. Code said public; URL not verified.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run Mask2Former and ConvNeXt-V2 UperNet as semantic baselines (mmseg) on BenchmarkEL with 1-ch replicated to 3, 512 px, house augmentation, same splits; check 1/4-res mask head on 1-2 px cracks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: Mask2Former (ConvNeXt-V2), 3 seeds, 40k iters. Baseline: house. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, mIoU_rob. Kill as a score arm if crack IoU < house - 0.02; keep as benchmark entry regardless.

alt_notes.adaptation: Mask2Former semantic head with ConvNeXt-V2-T or Swin-T, 1-channel input replicated, 512 px, 24 classes; targets blobby inactive and rare classes where query-based masks may help.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: Mask2Former + ConvNeXt-V2-T, 40k iters. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: mIoU_rob, inactive IoU, crack IoU. Kill if mIoU_rob < 0.580 and inactive IoU < 0.449.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use its model list in our suite; treat inactive regions as instances for an instance-level AP metric alongside IoU.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark only: Mask2Former and ConvNeXt-V2 entries under our protocol (covered by #2).

alt_notes.adaptation: Convert our masks to instances by connected components (cracks merged within 3 px) to get per-crack and per-inactive-region counts, lengths, severity; a benchmark/severity lever, not a strict-IoU lever. Its UCF split has train/test leakage.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark track: Mask2Former instance model vs house semantic model, scored on crack components >=20 px found and Boundary PQ; no kill line (suite member).

alt_notes.adaptation: Cite as the existing EL benchmark and the leakage example motivating clean splits; include Mask2Former / ConvNeXt-V2 in the method suite under our protocol.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark only: run Mask2Former and ConvNeXt-V2 under the BenchmarkEL protocol and report next to house model on clean-49 and E1. ~10 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Document the flaw: UCF-EL has heavy train/test leakage (BRIEF). Add Mask2Former / ConvNeXt-V2 under our protocol as the transformer and mask-classification entry.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Mask2Former (semantic) on our folds at matched compute. Baseline: house fold ensemble. Kill for score use: inactive IoU below the house model by more than 0.02.
